front.title: SCONE-Based Rate Advice for RoCEv2 Networks

abstract.t:
This document describes the applicable scenarios of the Standard Communication Protocol for Network Elements (SCONE) in RoCEv2 networks. SCONE defines a mechanism that enables network elements on the forwarding path to deliver throughput guidance to RoCEv2 endpoints. This document further specifies the method for carrying Rate Advice in RoCEv2 networks. The Rate Advice is generated by network nodes (e.g., switches), which can be either rate limits defined by network policies or quantitative rate adjustment recommendations derived from network status information.
This document specifies two implementation solutions with different granularities. Solution 1 provides path-granularity (source-IP- based) Rate Advice through out-of-band UDP messages sent directly from network elements to senders; a single advised rate applies to all active Queue Pairs (QPs) originating from the same source IP, providing sub-RTT feedback. Solution 2 provides per-flow (per-QP) Rate Advice through an on-path Rate Signal with endpoint feedback, reusing the RoCEv2 data path and following the feedback loop model of the SCONE protocol; each QP receives its own advised rate.
